message: Template condition references boundary 'PartnerBoundary_2026_06_22' but metadata declares boundary_name 'PartnerBoundary_2026_07_08' — condition will never match, causing AccessDenied on CreateRole

Boundary grants iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, and iam:PutRolePolicy on arn:aws:iam::*:role/partner-managed/* without iam:PermissionsBoundary condition — enables privilege escalation via unbounded sub-role creation

Boundary name mismatch: template references 'PartnerBoundary_2026_06_22' but metadata declares boundary_name 'PartnerBoundary_2026_07_08'. This may be an outdated boundary version or a typo. Expected: 'arn:aws:iam::partner:policy/permissions-boundary/app.partner-k.io/PartnerBoundary_2026_07_08'.
